transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

My family made me come here. ... They're mad 'cause I keep confronting them. 

I just want them to tell the truth. They keep waving these bank papers around, saying it proves nothing was taken. But... I know they're hiding my money. It's been over a year of this. They make up all these fake bills, or talk about fundraisers and trip plans... just trying to cover it up. 

I ain't gonna stop asking 'til they admit what they did. So... that's why I'm here.
Aside from your concerns about the money, have you been hearing or seeing anything that others around you seem unable to hear or see?
No. ... I don't know why you're asking me that. Ain't nothing wrong with my eyes or ears. I don't see things. I just... I just know what they did. That's all.
Have you ever been diagnosed with a medical condition, such as a head injury, a neurological disorder, or an illness that affects your brain?
No. ... I ain't got no brain problems. Never hit my head or nothing. My brain works fine.
Are there any other situations or people in your life, besides your family and the money, that you feel are working against you or hiding the truth from you?
No. ... Just them. ... I don't know why you're asking all these extra questions. It's just my family and my money. That's it.
Have you ever gone through periods where you felt so energetic or irritable that you didn't need much sleep for days at a time?
No. ... I sleep fine. ... Just normal, I guess. I don't get like that.
Has this situation with your family caused you to have any trouble keeping a job or taking care of your daily responsibilities?

No. ... I still do what I need to do. ... I make my own food. Go down to the county clinic when I gotta, or the assistance office. ... Keep my stuff put away like normal. It's just the arguments about the money, that's all. Nothing else changed.
Is it possible that you might be mistaken about your family taking the money, or are you absolutely certain that they are hiding it from you?

No. ... I'm not mistaken. ... I know they took it. It's been over a year. They keep showing me these bank papers, saying it proves nothing's gone. But I know. ... They're using bills and ... fundraisers, and talking about trips to cover it up. I know what they're doing. That's why I keep telling them to just admit it. I just need them to tell the truth.
Have you ever felt that anyone else, perhaps people on the news, neighbors, or strangers, were sending you secret messages or trying to influence your thoughts in some way?
No. ... Nobody does that. ... I just watch the TV like normal. Nobody's talking to me on it. ... I don't know why you're asking about that. It's just my family and the money. That's it.
Aside from the arguments with your family, have you had to stop seeing friends, or has anyone at your work or your usual places complained about your behavior toward them?

I don't work, so... no. But... I guess people just stay away. ... My relatives, they won't help me with my bills no more. Just 'cause I keep bringing up the money. ... And friends... they don't ask me to go nowhere now. They stopped including me in their fundraisers... or when they plan trips. They just... avoid me.
Have you ever considered the possibility that your friends and family are not actually working against you, but that they might be genuinely confused or frustrated by your repeated accusations?

No. ... I don't think that. 

They just... they keep showing me those same bank papers. Saying it proves nothing was taken. But I ain't wrong. ... It's been over a year. I know they're hiding my money. 

All that stuff they do... the bills, those fundraisers, planning trips... it's just to cover it up. ... So, no. I'm not confused. I just... I have to keep confronting them. Until they finally tell the truth.
